raw_problem.problem_text:
$$
\Theta (\theta) = A \ln [ \tan (\theta / 2) ]
$$

满足。 $\theta$ 的方程(方程 (4.25)). 这是不可接受的嘴 个解"一一错误出在哪里?
raw_problem.solution_text:
$\Theta \left( \theta \right) = A \mathrm { l n } \left[ \tan \left( \theta / 2 \right) \right]$ 和

$$
\sin \theta \frac {\mathrm {d}}{\mathrm {d} \theta} \left(\sin \theta \frac {\mathrm {d} \Theta}{\mathrm {d} \theta}\right) + \left[ \ell (\ell + 1) \sin^ {2} \theta - m ^ {2} \right] \Theta = 0,
$$

先处理求导项，得

$$
{\frac {\mathrm {d} \Theta}{\mathrm {d} \theta}} = {\frac {A}{\tan (\theta / 2)}} \cdot {\frac {1}{2}} \sec^ {2} {\frac {\theta}{2}} = {\frac {A}{2}} \cdot {\frac {\cos {\frac {\theta}{2}}}{\sin {\frac {\theta}{2}}}} \cdot {\frac {1}{\cos^ {2} {\frac {\theta}{2}}}} = {\frac {A}{\sin \theta}},
$$

$$
\frac {\mathrm {d}}{\mathrm {d} \theta} \left(\sin \theta \frac {\mathrm {d} \Theta}{\mathrm {d} \theta}\right) = \frac {\mathrm {d} A}{\mathrm {d} \theta} = 0.
$$

当 $\ell = m = 0$ 时，

$$
\ell (\ell + 1) \sin \theta^ {2} - m ^ {2} = 0,
$$

故 $\Theta \left( \theta \right)$ 满足方程

$$
\sin \theta \frac {\mathrm {d}}{\mathrm {d} \theta} \left(\sin \frac {\mathrm {d} \Theta}{\mathrm {d} \theta}\right) + \left[ \ell (\ell + 1) \sin \theta^ {2} - m ^ {2} \right] \Theta = 0.
$$

$\theta = 0$ 时， $\theta \left( 0 \right) = A \ln 0 = A \cdot \left( - \infty \right)$ ;当 $\theta = \pi$ 时， $\theta \left( \pi \right) = A \ln \left( \tan { \frac { \pi } { 2 } } \right) = A \ln \infty = A \cdot \infty .$ 所以，该解在物理上是不可接受的
